scripts.dev: npm run build -w @local-terminal/shared && npm run build -w @local-terminal/security && concurrently -n shared,security,gateway,web "npm run dev -w @local-terminal/shared" "npm run dev -w @local-terminal/security" "npm run dev -w @local-terminal/gateway" "npm run dev -w @local-terminal/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @local-terminal/shared && npm run build -w @local-terminal/security && npm run build -w @local-terminal/gateway && npm run build -w @local-terminal/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @local-terminal/shared && npm run test -w @local-terminal/security && npm run test -w @local-terminal/gateway && npm run test -w @local-terminal/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @local-terminal/shared && npm run lint -w @local-terminal/security && npm run lint -w @local-terminal/gateway && npm run lint -w @local-terminal/web && npm run lint:root
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @local-terminal/shared && npm run build -w @local-terminal/security && npm run typecheck -w @local-terminal/gateway && npm run typecheck -w @local-terminal/web && npm run typecheck -w @local-terminal/security && npm run typecheck -w @local-terminal/shared
